title: Turkey Talk with Chris Young: Your Nerdiest Turkey Questions Answered
contentHtml:
You asked, we answered. Chris Young and I team up to answer your most pressing turkey questions ahead of Thanksgiving Day.

Last month, I reached out to Frienjis here on Patreon and over on Instagram with a simple request: Submit your best turkey questions, trials, and tribulations.

Now, I'm teaming up with my friend Chris Young—former development chef at The Fat Duck and Modernist Cuisine, the designer behind Combustion Inc.'s Predictive Thermometer, and a food nerd in his own right—to answer your most pressing questions!

In this video, we'll be covering brining and salting; how to cut a turkey; how to check the temperature of a turkey; stuffing the turkey; whether the ever-elusive crispy skin is even possible (and how to achieve it); and wrap up with a lightning round. Grab your notebook, sit back, and let the food nerdery wash over you.
